description:
## What

Read-side cleanup. Agent.Loop accepts `convert_to_llm: ([AgentMessage] -> [Message])` — a stateless transform applied at LLM-call time. Required at `start_link` (no nil fallback).

`build_turn_context/1` becomes:

```elixir
defp build_turn_context(loop) do
  %AIContext{
    system_prompt: loop.system_prompt,
    messages: loop.convert_to_llm.(MessageLog.to_list(loop.messages)),
    tools: Enum.map(loop.tools, &agent_tool_to_ai_tool/1)
  }
end
```

Coder.Loop.init installs `&OctoPi.Coder.Session.Messages.to_llm/1`. The closure-over-coder_pid pattern from opi-qy9 goes away — no more `Coder.build_session_context` round-trip per turn.

## Why

`messages_provider` exists because we override Agent's *read path*. After this ticket the read path is just `loop.messages` again; the only knob is "how do you flatten this for the LLM." That's `convert_to_llm` — a function, not a provider.

## Files

- `apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/loop.ex` — `messages_provider` field renamed/typed; `build_turn_context/1` updated.
- `apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/loop/state.ex` — field rename.
- `apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent.ex` — drop `set_messages_provider/2`; `start_loop/1` accepts `convert_to_llm`.
- `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/loop.ex` — install `to_llm/1` at start_link, not via post-init setter.

## Out of scope

- Any change to who writes to `loop.messages`. Agent still pushes assistant + tool_results from streamed turns; Coder still has no write API yet (lands in opi-y0a.2).
- Compaction or navigation semantics.

## Done when

- `messages_provider` removed from Agent.Loop.State.
- `convert_to_llm` is required at start_link; tests that don't supply one fail with `KeyError`.
- All existing tests pass without messages_provider being referenced.
title: Replace messages_provider with stateless convert_to_llm
